ayahs.ar: يسٓ
ayahs.en: Ya, Seen
ayahs.e2: Yâ-Sĩn
ayahs.tr: Yaa-Seeen

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
ayahs.en: By the wise Qur'an
ayahs.e2: By the Quran, rich in wisdom
ayahs.tr: Wal-Qur-aanil-Hakeem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.en: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers
ayahs.e2: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers
ayahs.tr: Innaka laminal mursaleen

ayahs.ar: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطࣲ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: On a straight path
ayahs.e2: upon the Straight Path
ayahs.tr: Alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.en: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful
ayahs.e2: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful
ayahs.tr: Tanzeelal 'Azeezir Raheem

ayahs.ar: لِتُنذِرَ قَوۡمࣰ ا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غَٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.en: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware
ayahs.e2: so that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so are heedless
ayahs.tr: Litunzira qawmam maaa unzira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe
ayahs.e2: The decree ˹of torment˺ has already been justified against most of them, for they will never believe
ayahs.tr: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيٓ أَعۡنَٰقِهِمۡ أَغۡلَٰلࣰ ا فَهِيَ إِلَى ٱلۡأَذۡقَانِ فَهُم مُّقۡمَحُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft
ayahs.e2: ˹It is as if˺ We have put shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up
ayahs.tr: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal azqaani fahum muqmahoon

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدࣰّ ا فَأَغۡشَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see
ayahs.e2: and have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them ˹all˺ up, so they fail to see ˹the truth˺
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw-wa min khalfihim saddan fa aghshai naahum fahum laa yubsiroon

ayahs.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَأَنذَرۡتَهُمۡ أَمۡ لَمۡ تُنذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
ayahs.en: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe
ayahs.e2: It is the same whether you warn them or not—they will never believe
ayahs.tr: Wa sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةࣲ وَأَجۡرࣲ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.en: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward
ayahs.e2: You can only warn those who follow the Reminder and are in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing Him. So give them good news of forgiveness and an honourable reward
ayahs.tr: Innamaa tunziru manit taba 'az-Zikra wa khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُواْ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمۡۚ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ أَحۡصَيۡنَٰهُ فِيٓ إِمَامࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register
ayahs.e2: It is certainly We Who resurrect the dead, and write what they send forth and what they leave behind. Everything is listed by Us in a perfect Record
ayahs.tr: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa wa naktubu maa qaddamoo wa aasaarahum; wa kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَٱضۡرِبۡ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَةِ إِذۡ جَآءَهَا ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it
ayahs.e2: Give them an example ˹O Prophet˺ of the residents of a town, when the messengers came to them
ayahs.tr: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; iz jaaa'ahal mursaloon

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ أَرۡسَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡهِمُ ٱثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثࣲ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُم مُّرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you
ayahs.e2: We sent them two messengers, but they rejected both. So We reinforced ˹the two˺ with a third, and they declared, “We have indeed been sent to you ˹as messengers˺.”
ayahs.tr: Iz arsalnaaa ilaihimusnaini fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ مَآ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَرࣱ مِّثۡلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ مِن شَيۡءٍ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا تَكۡذِبُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies
ayahs.e2: The people replied, “You are only humans like us, and the Most Compassionate has not revealed anything. You are simply lying!”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa wa maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takziboon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you
ayahs.e2: The messengers responded, “Our Lord knows that we have truly been sent to you
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
ayahs.en: And we are not responsible except for clear notification
ayahs.e2: And our duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.”
ayahs.tr: Wa maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۖ لَئِن لَّمۡ تَنتَهُواْ لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment
ayahs.e2: The people replied, “We definitely see you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you ˹to death˺ and you will be touched with a painful punishment from us.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il-lam tantahoo lanar jumannakum wa la-yamassan nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمۡ أَئِن ذُكِّرۡتُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣱ مُّسۡرِفُونَ
ayahs.en: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people
ayahs.e2: The messengers said, “Your bad omen lies within yourselves. Are you saying this because you are reminded ˹of the truth˺? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ أَقۡصَا ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ رَجُلࣱ يَسۡعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ ٱتَّبِعُواْ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
ayahs.en: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers
ayahs.e2: Then from the farthest end of the city a man came, rushing. He advised, “O my people! Follow the messengers
ayahs.tr: Wa jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluny yas'aa qaala yaa qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen

ayahs.ar: ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَن لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا وَهُم مُّهۡتَدُونَ
ayahs.en: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided
ayahs.e2: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and are ˹rightly˺ guided
ayahs.tr: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon

ayahs.ar: وَمَالِيَ لَآ أَعۡبُدُ ٱلَّذِي فَطَرَنِي وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned
ayahs.e2: And why should I not worship the One Who has originated me, and to Whom you will be returned
ayahs.tr: Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon

ayahs.ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدۡنِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ بِضُرࣲّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
ayahs.en: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me
ayahs.e2: How could I take besides Him other gods whose intercession would not be of any benefit to me, nor could they save me if the Most Compassionate intended to harm me
ayahs.tr: A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon

ayahs.ar: إِنِّيٓ إِذࣰ ا لَّفِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.en: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error
ayahs.e2: Indeed, I would then be clearly astray
ayahs.tr: Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen

ayahs.ar: إِنِّيٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَٱسۡمَعُونِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me
ayahs.e2: I do believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”
ayahs.tr: Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon

ayahs.ar: قِيلَ ٱدۡخُلِ ٱلۡجَنَّةَۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِي يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
ayahs.e2: ˹But they killed him, then˺ he was told ˹by the angels˺, “Enter Paradise!” He said, “If only my people knew
ayahs.tr: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
ayahs.en: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored
ayahs.e2: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honourable.”
ayahs.tr: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen

ayahs.ar: ۞وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ مِن جُندࣲ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.en: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so
ayahs.e2: We did not send any soldiers from the heavens against his people after his death, nor did We need to
ayahs.tr: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen

ayahs.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ خَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.en: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished
ayahs.e2: All it took was one ˹mighty˺ blast, and they were extinguished at once
ayahs.tr: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon

ayahs.ar: يَٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَى ٱلۡعِبَادِۚ مَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
ayahs.en: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him
ayahs.e2: Oh pity, such beings! No messenger ever came to them without being mocked
ayahs.tr: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon

ayahs.ar: أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمۡ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.en: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return
ayahs.e2: Have the deniers not considered how many peoples We destroyed before them who never came back to life again
ayahs.tr: Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon

ayahs.ar: وَإِن كُلࣱّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us
ayahs.e2: Yet they will all be brought before Us
ayahs.tr: Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon

ayahs.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبࣰّ ا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat
ayahs.e2: There is a sign for them in the dead earth: We give it life, producing grain from it for them to eat
ayahs.tr: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتࣲ مِّن نَّخِيلࣲ وَأَعۡنَٰبࣲ وَفَجَّرۡنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلۡعُيُونِ
ayahs.en: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs
ayahs.e2: And We have placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth in it
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon

ayahs.ar: لِيَأۡكُلُواْ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ أَيۡدِيهِمۡۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.en: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful
ayahs.e2: so that they may eat from its fruit, which they had no hand in making. Will they not then give thanks
ayahs.tr: Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon

ayahs.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَزۡوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ أَنفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know
ayahs.e2: Glory be to the One Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs—˹be it˺ what the earth produces, their genders, or what they do not know
ayahs.tr: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon

ayahs.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيۡلُ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظۡلِمُونَ
ayahs.en: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness
ayahs.e2: There is also a sign for them in the night: We strip from it daylight, then—behold!—they are in darkness
ayahs.tr: Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon

ayahs.ar: وَٱلشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِي لِمُسۡتَقَرࣲّ لَّهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
ayahs.en: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing
ayahs.e2: The sun travels for its fixed term. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing
ayahs.tr: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem

ayahs.ar: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
ayahs.en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk
ayahs.e2: As for the moon, We have ordained ˹precise˺ phases for it, until it ends up like an old, curved palm stalk
ayahs.tr: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem

ayahs.ar: لَا ٱلشَّمۡسُ يَنۢبَغِي لَهَآ أَن تُدۡرِكَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِۚ وَكُلࣱّ فِي فَلَكࣲ يَسۡبَحُونَ
ayahs.en: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming
ayahs.e2: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor does the night outrun the day. Each is travelling in an orbit of their own
ayahs.tr: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon

ayahs.ar: وَءَايَةࣱ لَّهُمۡ أَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡفُلۡكِ ٱلۡمَشۡحُونِ
ayahs.en: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship
ayahs.e2: Another sign for them is that We carried their ancestors ˹with Noah˺ in the fully loaded Ark
ayahs.tr: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon

ayahs.ar: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثۡلِهِۦ مَا يَرۡكَبُونَ
ayahs.en: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride
ayahs.e2: and created for them similar things to ride in
ayahs.tr: Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon

ayahs.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنقَذُونَ
ayahs.en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
ayahs.e2: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—
ayahs.tr: Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time
ayahs.e2: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while
ayahs.tr: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُواْ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُونَ
ayahs.en: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy
ayahs.e2: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةࣲ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
ayahs.en: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away
ayahs.e2: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it
ayahs.tr: Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen

ayahs.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ أَنفِقُواْ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَنُطۡعِمُ مَن لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطۡعَمَهُۥٓ إِنۡ أَنتُمۡ إِلَّا فِي ضَلَٰلࣲ مُّبِينࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error
ayahs.e2: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلۡوَعۡدُ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful
ayahs.e2: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”
ayahs.tr: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ تَأۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُونَ
ayahs.en: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing
ayahs.e2: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes
ayahs.tr: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ تَوۡصِيَةࣰ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return
ayahs.e2: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people
ayahs.tr: Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.en: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten
ayahs.e2: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord
ayahs.tr: Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
ayahs.en: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth
ayahs.e2: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”
ayahs.tr: Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon

ayahs.ar: إِن كَانَتۡ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ فَإِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيعࣱ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.en: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us
ayahs.e2: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us
ayahs.tr: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon

ayahs.ar: فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسࣱ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا وَلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do
ayahs.e2: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do
ayahs.tr: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ فِي شُغُلࣲ فَٰكِهُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation
ayahs.e2: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves
ayahs.tr: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon

ayahs.ar: هُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُهُمۡ فِي ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.en: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches
ayahs.e2: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches
ayahs.tr: Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon

ayahs.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةࣱ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.en: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
ayahs.e2: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire
ayahs.tr: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon

ayahs.ar: سَلَٰمࣱ قَوۡلࣰ ا مِّن رَّبࣲّ رَّحِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord
ayahs.e2: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord
ayahs.tr: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem

ayahs.ar: وَٱمۡتَٰزُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
ayahs.en: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals
ayahs.e2: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O wicked ones
ayahs.tr: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon

ayahs.ar: ۞أَلَمۡ أَعۡهَدۡ إِلَيۡكُمۡ يَٰبَنِيٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعۡبُدُواْ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنَۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمۡ عَدُوࣱّ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy
ayahs.e2: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy
ayahs.tr: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَأَنِ ٱعۡبُدُونِيۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطࣱ مُّسۡتَقِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path
ayahs.e2: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path
ayahs.tr: Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمۡ جِبِلࣰّ ا كَثِيرًاۖ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُونُواْ تَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.en: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason
ayahs.e2: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon

ayahs.ar: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.en: This is the Hellfire which you were promised
ayahs.e2: This is the Hell you were warned of
ayahs.tr: Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon

ayahs.ar: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُونَ
ayahs.en: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny
ayahs.e2: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”
ayahs.tr: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon

ayahs.ar: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
ayahs.en: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn
ayahs.e2: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit
ayahs.tr: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَٱسۡتَبَقُواْ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبۡصِرُونَ
ayahs.en: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see
ayahs.e2: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see
ayahs.tr: Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مُضِيࣰّ ا وَلَا يَرۡجِعُونَ
ayahs.en: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return
ayahs.e2: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back
ayahs.tr: Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon

ayahs.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
ayahs.en: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand
ayahs.e2: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand
ayahs.tr: Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِي لَهُۥٓۚ إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ وَقُرۡءَانࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
ayahs.e2: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran
ayahs.tr: Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen

ayahs.ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيࣰّ ا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers
ayahs.e2: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers
ayahs.tr: Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ أَيۡدِينَآ أَنۡعَٰمࣰ ا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
ayahs.en: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners
ayahs.e2: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control
ayahs.tr: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon

ayahs.ar: وَذَلَّلۡنَٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat
ayahs.e2: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others
ayahs.tr: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمۡ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُۚ أَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُونَ
ayahs.en: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful
ayahs.e2: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks
ayahs.tr: Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon

ayahs.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةࣰ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.en: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped
ayahs.e2: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺
ayahs.tr: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُندࣱ مُّحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.en: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance
ayahs.e2: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards
ayahs.tr: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ إِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
ayahs.en: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare
ayahs.e2: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal
ayahs.tr: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَمۡ يَرَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُ مِن نُّطۡفَةࣲ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمࣱ مُّبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary
ayahs.e2: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺
ayahs.tr: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen

ayahs.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلࣰ ا وَنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهُۥۖ قَالَ مَن يُحۡيِ ٱلۡعِظَٰمَ وَهِيَ رَمِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated
ayahs.e2: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”
ayahs.tr: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيهَا ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةࣲۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.en: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing
ayahs.e2: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being
ayahs.tr: Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلۡأَخۡضَرِ نَارࣰ ا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنۡهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ayahs.en: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite
ayahs.e2: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them
ayahs.tr: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon

ayahs.ar: أَوَلَيۡسَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلۡخَلَّٰقُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
ayahs.en: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator
ayahs.e2: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing
ayahs.tr: Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem

ayahs.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is
ayahs.e2: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is
ayahs.tr: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon

ayahs.ar: فَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
ayahs.en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned
ayahs.e2: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned
ayahs.tr: Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon
